note:
The realization choices the Wide Zone Advantage contract leaves open. A REALIZER's input, not knowledge: nothing here is authored, and the realization record keeps it separate from what was derived. RESTORED 13 October 2026 into a file of its own: the two channel-extent choices that sat in `a04-realization-choices.json` until 8 October and were pruned from it when Beat Defenders 1v1 stopped selecting Wide Zone Advantage. They belong to this knowledge object rather than to any Learning Goal, which is why they were filed under it (see `realization-choices-index.json`). 

EMPTIED later on 13 October 2026, as that note said it would be. The two entries were `c:restated:WIDE-ZONE-ADVANTAGE:WIDEZONE-02.a::S5` and `c:restated:WIDE-ZONE-ADVANTAGE:WIDEZONE-03::S5`, each with the value "the full axis extent, end line to end line" and the reason "the single member of Wide Zone's authored bound for a channel's along-extent". Neither was a choice: the bound on each line has exactly one member and any other value is refused. Such a line is now closed by rule -- a justified default, `ONLY_MEMBER_OF_AUTHORED_BOUND`, produced in `back/src/system/realization/justified-defaults.ts` and recorded as a default rather than as something somebody chose. The values in the game are the same ones. This contract therefore leaves NOTHING open that needs a decision, and the file says so by being empty rather than by being absent: an entry added here is still read whenever the object is selected and contracted, so a real decision this object comes to need has a place to go.
